name: Beatrice of Burgundy
note: heir in Bourbonnais after the death of her mother Agnes in 1287; her son Louis became first Duke of Bourbon (1327), superseding the rank of seigneur

name: Louis I
note: first duke; Sire de Bourbon page: created 1327, absorbing the lordship

name: Louise of Savoy
note: in 1531 the duchy merged into the royal domain; later creations (1544 onward) were appanages/courtesy titles and are not listed
